_comment: Corrections to the box membership recorded in cards.json, keyed by box key. Each entry is authoritative for that box: on load the box is stripped from every card's containedIn, then re-added from the list here. Card ids map to quantityPerBox. Use this when the community data groups a set wrongly, rather than editing cards.json, which is regenerated from the builder bundle.

LAB_PD_REAPER_TYPE_1._note: The community data put four Reaper variants in this one box at 1 each. The product listing sells each Reaper alone, 2 copies per box, matching how Type E was already recorded.

LAB_PD_REAPER_TYPE_2._note: Was empty in the community data; MD-4B was filed under the Type 1 box.

LAB_PD_CRISIS1._note: The retail LAB-CRISIS H2-A box prints 6 Part Cards, 1 Pilot Card, 1 Projectile Card and 4 Projectile miniatures. The community data had only five parts here and filed BOTH HL2 chassis under the H2-B box, which leaves this kit with no legs to stand on. The base HL2 chassis (548) is the sixth card; the two kits share it, which is what the product's modular-magnetic-parts design implies. INFERRED from the printed card count - check a physical box if one turns up. PDAM-002 is the Exocet both backpacks launch.

LAB_PD_CRISIS2._note: Restated rather than changed: this file is authoritative per box, so a box named here must list everything it ships. Torso, both chassis, both arms and the backpack are the 6 Part Cards.

_unlisted: MD-4C Reaper Type III (PRDR-102) and MD-4D Reaper Type IV (PRDR-103) were also filed under the Type 1 box, which is wrong, but no box is known to ship them. They are deliberately left with no box rather than guessed into one. Add an entry above if a listing turns up. The same applies to the PD pilots: the LAB-CRISIS boxes each print 1 Pilot Card and four Planet Rings pilots exist (XPA-59 to XPA-62, all Link 5, matching the H2-A listing's "5 Link Value"), but nothing says which pilot ships in which box, so they stay unassigned - a card with no box is treated as "cannot tell, show it" rather than "not owned".
